title: Documents
templateCreated: Template created. Customize the fields that vary between customers.
clientDocumentCreated: Customer document created. Check the details before presenting it.
templatesHelp: Create a reusable base and generate a copy for each customer. Each copy has its own edits and signature.
copyTemplateHelp: Creates a reusable copy. Replace customer-specific details with fields such as nome_cliente inside double braces. Also check information printed in the original PDF. Collected signatures and owner authorizations are not copied.
useTemplateHelp: Enter the details below to create a new customer document. The template stays available for future customers.
noTemplateVariables: This template has no variable fields yet. You can edit the customer details manually in the generated copy.
templateEditingHelp: Write variable fields inside double braces, as shown below. For PDFs, use them in added text or fillable fields. Save and select Use template to create a customer copy.
prepareRequired: Enter the customer name and position their signature before continuing.
help_edit: Finalize the text and customer details. Signatures will be configured in the next step.
help_prepare: With the document ready, identify the customer and choose each signature position. Then present the saved version to the customer.
help_review: Show the complete document to the customer. Use Previous and Next to review its pages and request their signature once they finish.
description: Edit text, fill PDFs and collect in-person customer signatures.
emptyHelp: Create a text document or import a PDF or TXT file to get started.
placeHelp: Click the page to add text at that position, or use Add text.
drawSignature: Draw your signature with your mouse or finger.
pdfLimit: Import a PDF up to 10 MB.
textLimit: Import a TXT file up to 300 KB and 100,000 characters.
signedSuccess: Document signed and final version preserved.
locked: This version cannot be edited. History and the signed PDF remain available.
textHelp: Font, text width and A4 margins match the PDF. The preview updates as you edit and shows final page breaks.
pdfHelp: Fill available form fields and add text to pages. Original PDF text is preserved; text replacement and OCR are not supported.
saveBeforeSign: This preview includes unsaved changes. Save and review the final version before handing the screen to the customer.
signDescription: Hand the screen to the customer to read, draw and confirm their signature. Their identity is declared in person; the collecting user, date and version are recorded. The signature appears at the chosen position and on an additional audit page. No ICP-Brasil certificate is used. Confirmation locks the document.
onsiteHelp: Identify the customer signing in person. Choose the position in the preview before saving and collecting the signature.
clickSignature: Click the PDF to position: {signer}. Use Previous/Next to choose another page.
dragSignature: Drag the area to move; drag the blue corner to resize. Keyboard: arrows move, Alt + arrows resize.
noOwnerSignature: The account owner has not authorized a default signature. Set it up using the link below.
ownerSettingsHelp: Draw your signature once to reuse it in account documents. This is not a gov.br integration or a digital certificate.
ownerOnly: Only the account owner can register or change the default signature.
ownerAuthorization: I authorize users of my account who can edit documents to include this default signature in documents they prepare.
ownerRevocation: Uncheck the authorization and save to suspend new uses. Already signed documents stay unchanged; drafts using the previous authorization must be updated.
consent: I have read the document and confirm my electronic signature on this version.
discard: You have unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?
